about.title: About Laneway Bank
about.lede: Laneway Bank isn't a real bank. It's a working demonstration of what a bank's website measures, and what it does with what it learns.
body: A home loan application is one of the longest journeys anyone takes on a website. People start it, stop, compare rates somewhere else, come back a week later, and call someone halfway through. Each step leaves a trace.

Laneway Bank makes those traces visible. Every calculator run, every application stage and every message is sent to Amplitude for analysis and to Braze for engagement, and the event stream in the corner shows both as they happen.

Everything here is simulated. The rates are invented, the credit decisions are arithmetic, and the customers are personas. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere except those two tools, and no real account or loan is ever created.

talk.title: Talk to a home lender
talk.lede: Some people apply without talking to anyone. Some want a person from the first question. Either works here.

items.name: Mobile lender
items.body: A lender comes to you, at home or at work, seven days a week. Bring your questions and your payslips.
items.bestFor: Best for first home buyers and anyone with a complicated income.

items.name: Video appointment
items.body: Thirty minutes on screen with a lender, who can walk through your numbers and your options with you.
items.bestFor: Best if you've already used the calculators and want a second opinion.

items.name: Phone callback
items.body: Tell us when suits and a lender calls you. Usually within one business day.
items.bestFor: Best for quick questions about rates, switching or your application.

talk.formNote: Leave your details and a lender will be in touch within one business day.
talk.disclaimer: Laneway Bank is a simulation. Requests demonstrate how lead capture works across Amplitude and Braze, and nobody will call.

products.title: Variable Home Loan
products.tagline: Our lowest-fuss loan. No application fee, no annual fee, free redraw.
products.description: A straightforward variable rate loan for the home you live in. Make extra repayments whenever you like and draw them back out if you need them, with no fee either way.
features: No application, annual or monthly fees
Unlimited extra repayments and free redraw
Borrow up to 90% of the property value (lenders mortgage insurance applies above 80%)
Split part of the loan into a fixed rate at any time

products.title: Package Home Loan
products.tagline: A 100% offset account and a fee-free Rewards Card, for one annual fee.
products.description: Every dollar in your offset account comes off the balance we charge interest on. On a big loan with savings behind it, the offset is usually worth far more than the annual fee.
features: Up to 10 offset accounts, each offsetting 100% of its balance
Annual fee waived on the Laneway Rewards Card
Borrow up to 95% of the property value
Interest-only repayments available for up to 5 years

Extra repayments up to $10,000 a year without break costs
Free rate lock when you apply

products.title: Everyday Account
products.tagline: The account your pay goes into. No monthly fees, ever.

products.tagline: An everyday account that brings down your home loan interest.

No monthly account fees
